text_blocks.snippet: Research indicates that the symptoms of OCD include unwanted, intrusive thoughts, images, or urges, often accompanied by repetitive behaviors or mental acts (compulsions) performed to alleviate the distress caused by these obsessions. These symptoms are typically recognized by the individual as irrational or excessive, but they have difficulty stopping them.
